# Upstream PGSTAR & PGBINARY Coverage Report (MESA `26.4.1`)

Generated mechanically from MESA `26.4.1` `star/defaults/pgstar.defaults`, `binary/defaults/pgbinary.defaults`, and `astero/defaults/astero_pgstar.defaults` paired with `flexmesa.plotting.pgstar_coverage` (`#173`). All plots read strictly from saved `history.data`, `binary_history.data`, `profileN.data`, and MESA `26.4.1` `plot_info` files (`flexmesa plot compare` / `profile` / `kipp` / `rti` / `binary` / `track` / `cmd` / `text-summary` / `grid` / `watch`).

The status of each family is assigned by hand in `flexmesa.plotting.pgstar_coverage` from a reading of the upstream window source. The generator checks only that every upstream window family has a row and that each named builder exists. No figure has been compared with a PGSTAR or PGBINARY rendering, so `equivalent` means the builder is intended to draw the same quantities, and `partial` rows say what is known to be missing.
